name: GitHub MCP Server

demo.title: Extending AI Agents: A live demo of the GitHub MCP Server

what: Official MCP server from GitHub that lets AI tools read repositories and code, manage issues and pull requests, check GitHub Actions runs and review security findings, all through natural language.
who: Developers who want their AI assistant to read code, triage issues or open PRs without leaving the chat.

setup.text: Easiest: in an MCP host with remote-server support (VS Code 1.101+, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, etc.), add the HTTP server and sign in with OAuth (or send a GitHub PAT as a Bearer header). VS Code config:
Or run it locally with Docker (Docker must be running):
Optionally limit what the agent can do with toolsets or turn on read-only mode (or GITHUB_READ_ONLY=1):

prompts: List the open issues labeled 'bug' in my repo and group them by area.
Summarize what changed in pull request #42 and flag anything risky.
Why did the latest GitHub Actions run on main fail? Show me the failing job's logs.
